name: Traffic Design Studio
tagline: Check a site's traffic impact — demand, level of service, entry geometry — against IRC standards.
description: Runs a traffic-impact check for a site — roadway capacity and level-of-service grading, junction capacity, and an entry/deceleration-lane geometry drawn to scale against the IRC:86-1983 formula — and produces a pass/fail verdict register and report.

page.objective: Get an early, standards-based read on a site's traffic impact before a formal traffic study is commissioned.
page.problem: Traffic-impact checks — level of service, junction capacity, deceleration-lane geometry — are normally a specialist calculation done late in design.
page.solution: Site location, demand, and modal-split inputs drive a live level-of-service grade, a to-scale entry-geometry drawing against the IRC formula, and a verdict register.

highlights.headline: Entry geometry and level-of-service, worked out live against IRC formulas.
points: Grades roadway capacity and level of service from demand and modal-split assumptions.
Draws entry geometry and deceleration-lane length to scale, with the IRC:86-1983 formula annotated live.
Runs junction capacity analysis and rolls every check into a pass/fail verdict register.
